title: Prediction
description: Predict when memo hooks are worth adding.
prompt: Which reason best justifies adding useMemo to a calculation?

options.label: Every calculation in render should be wrapped in useMemo.
The calculation is expensive enough to matter and its inputs change predictably.
useMemo prevents the component from re-rendering.

responses.every-calculation: Not quite. useMemo adds complexity and should not wrap cheap calculations by default.
responses.expensive-measured-work: Correct. useMemo is useful when avoiding a specific recalculation is worth the dependency and readability cost.
responses.avoid-all-renders: Not quite. useMemo can cache a value, but it does not stop the component itself from rendering.

metadata.reason: Catches premature useMemo usage and confusion about what it prevents.
